name: Simplero
description_en:
Simplero is a hosted business platform for coaches and course creators, combining a website and landing pages with courses, email, contacts, communities, checkout and automations. Its value proposition is a connected sales-and-delivery workflow rather than a standalone page designer. Higher tiers add affiliate programs, upsells, API access, pipelines and more administration controls.

Evaluate one complete offer: sales page, product/price, payment, participant access and follow-up email. Plan cost depends on contacts, storage, scheduling users, AI and text messaging as well as the base subscription. Billing is explicitly every 30 days or 360 days, not calendar months/years.
description_zh:
Simplero 是面向教练和课程创作者的托管业务平台，将网站和落地页与课程、邮件、联系人、社区、结账和自动化结合。核心价值是连接销售与交付流程，而非单独页面设计器。更高方案增加联盟计划、追加销售、API、销售管道和更多管理控制。

应围绕完整产品验证：销售页、商品/价格、支付、参与者访问和跟进邮件。费用除基础订阅外，还取决于联系人、存储、预约用户、AI 和短信。计费明确按 30 天或 360 天，不是自然月/自然年。

core_features.explanation_en: Products can use a catalog page, Simplero landing page, multi-step funnel or external sales page linked to an order form.
core_features.explanation_zh: 商品可使用目录页、Simplero 落地页、多步漏斗或连接订单表单的外部销售页。

core_features.explanation_en: Courses, contacts, email and automations share the business platform; entitlement and contract options still differ by plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 课程、联系人、邮件和自动化同处平台，但访问权和合同选项仍按方案区分。

core_features.explanation_en: Contacts/storage can be expanded without a tier change; AI is a shared dollar allowance and SMS has per-segment charges.
core_features.explanation_zh: 联系人/存储可不换档扩容，AI 为共享金额额度，短信另按分段收费。

pricing.summary_en: Starter/Scale/Skyrocket monthly displays $70/$179/$299 per 30-day billing, or $59/$149/$249 monthly equivalents on 360-day billing, before tax. Contacts/storage can auto-expand for extra charges; processors, SMS, AI top-ups and branded app add costs.
pricing.summary_zh: Starter/Scale/Skyrocket 按 30 天账期显示 $70/$179/$299，360 天账期月均显示 $59/$149/$249，税前。联系人/存储可自动扩容收费，支付商、短信、AI 加购和品牌应用另计。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Build a sellable offer before polishing the whole site
sections.title_zh: 先构建可销售产品再完善整站
sections.en: The documented product flow is Sales → Products → Create new product, choose a type, then enter name, subtitle, description, card image, listing status and base price. Only the name is required, so completing the wizard is not proof a sale is ready. Listed, unlisted-by-link and closed are distinct selling states. Select a sales page under product settings: catalog copy, a built landing page, a funnel or an existing external page. For a funnel, explicitly add/link the order form. Configure participant access, tax, emails and automations for the intended product and verify the result with a test purchaser/participant before launch.
sections.zh: 文档商品流程为 Sales → Products → Create new product，选择类型后填写名称、副标题、描述、卡片图片、上架状态和基础价格。仅名称必填，完成向导不证明已可销售。目录展示、仅链接可购和关闭是不同状态。可在商品设置选择目录文案、已有落地页、漏斗或外部销售页，漏斗须明确加入/链接订单表单。应按目标产品设置参与者访问、税费、邮件及自动化，并在上线前用测试购买者/参与者验证结果。

sections.title_en: Distinguish purchaser, participant and contract state
sections.title_zh: 区分购买者、参与者与合同状态
sections.en: The product guide distinguishes the buyer from a different course participant; when they differ, the contract request goes to the participant email. Checkbox contracts are described on all plans, but before-payment/after-payment contracts require Scale or Skyrocket. Administrative options can activate a participant with or without executing a contract, so establish who may use those controls instead of assuming every activation is a user signature. Configure sales start/end, capacity, payment plans and paused-purchase content access deliberately. The homepage’s illustrative customer/revenue/dashboard examples were not treated as measured customer outcomes.
sections.zh: 商品指南区分购买者和可能不同的课程参与者，两者不同时合同请求发送到参与者邮件。所有方案描述有复选框合同，但付款前/付款后合同要求 Scale 或 Skyrocket。管理选项能在执行或不执行合同的情况下激活参与者，因此应明确谁有权使用这些控制，不能把每次激活当作用户签名。销售起止、容量、分期及暂停购买后的内容访问均应主动配置。首页示意客户/收入/面板例子不作为已测客户成果。

sections.title_en: Budget the 30-day or 360-day plan and overages
sections.title_zh: 核算 30 天或 360 天方案及超额
sections.en: Prices are USD before tax. Starter displays $70 on monthly billing or $59/month equivalent annually, with 10 products/courses, one site/community, 500 contacts, 250 GB, one scheduling user and $5 AI allowance. Scale displays $179/$149 equivalent, unlimited products/courses/sites, 1,000 contacts, 1 TB, three scheduling users, five custom domains and $15 AI allowance. Skyrocket displays $299/$249 equivalent, 5,000 contacts, unlimited storage/domains, 25 scheduling users and $30 AI allowance. The terms say billing is in advance every 30/360 days. Contacts over the limit or storage approaching it trigger automatic capacity provisioning and an immediate prorated charge; do not assume unlimited email sends makes contact growth free. Verify the calculator’s actual capacity quote.
sections.zh: 价格为税前美元。Starter 月付显示 $70、年付月均 $59，含 10 个商品/课程、一个站点/社区、500 联系人、250 GB、一个预约用户和 $5 AI 额度。Scale 为 $179/$149 月均，商品/课程/站点不限，含 1,000 联系人、1 TB、三个预约用户、五个自定义域名及 $15 AI。Skyrocket 为 $299/$249 月均，含 5,000 联系人、无限存储/域名、25 个预约用户和 $30 AI。条款说按 30/360 天预收。联系人超过上限或存储接近上限时自动配置容量并立即按比例收费，邮件发送不限不代表联系人增长免费，应核对计算器的实际容量报价。

sections.title_en: Separate service fees from payment processing
sections.title_zh: 区分平台费用与支付处理
sections.en: Simplero says it charges no transaction fee, while the customer’s processor charges its own fees. Video hosting/email delivery are included, but SMS on Scale/Skyrocket is charged per segment by country/provider. AI allowance resets every 30 days, is shared across transcription/chat/image and other features, and can be topped up; the approximately $0.50/hour transcription figure is an estimate subject to provider costs. A branded mobile app requires separate Apple/Google developer accounts and an additional monthly fee. Concierge services are optional paid engagements. The 90-days-for-$90 promotion and $47 Offer Bot with 30 Starter days are separate offers; they are not the standard continuing subscription.
sections.zh: Simplero 表示不收交易费，但客户支付处理商仍收自己的费用。视频托管/邮件投递包含在方案内，Scale/Skyrocket 短信按国家/服务商分段收费。AI 额度每 30 天重置，供转录、聊天、图片等功能共享，可加购；约 $0.50/小时转录仅为受服务商成本影响的估算。品牌手机应用需独立 Apple/Google 开发者账户及额外月费。Concierge 是可选付费服务。90 天 $90 活动与含 30 天 Starter 的 $47 Offer Bot 是独立优惠，不是标准持续订阅价。

sections.title_en: Plan trial conversion, cancellation and migration
sections.title_zh: 规划试用转付费、取消及迁移
sections.en: The 14-day trial unlocks features but temporarily caps email until sender verification. Terms say trials can automatically charge the card for the next agreed period, with a reminder at least seven days before the trial ends; confirm the specific offer’s checkout. Billing controls are Settings → Plan & Billing, including plan changes and the account-closure link. Pricing promises a full refund in the first 30 days, while terms phrase this as within 30 days “of the end of your first payment”; confirm the operative deadline rather than extending it to renewals or unused time. Repeated failed charges can lead to suspension then permanent deletion. Keep exports and a migration inventory of contacts, media, courses, payment subscriptions and access rights before closure; complete export/self-hosting was not established. No account, purchase, contract, email delivery or migration was executed here.
sections.zh: 14 天试用开放功能，但验证发信者前邮件有临时上限。条款称试用结束可自动向卡扣取下一约定周期，并至少提前七天提醒，需核对具体优惠结账条件。方案变更和关闭链接位于 Settings → Plan & Billing。定价页承诺前 30 天全额退款，条款却使用首笔付款结束后 30 天内的措辞，实际截止日需确认，不能扩大为续费或未使用时间可退。多次扣款失败可能先暂停再永久删除。关闭前应保留导出，并清点联系人、媒体、课程、支付订阅和访问权迁移，当前未确立完整导出或自托管。本次未执行账户、购买、合同、邮件投递或迁移。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Actual capacity overage quote, refund-deadline wording, specific promotion conversion, full exports and service retention require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 实际容量超额报价、退款截止措辞、具体优惠转付费、完整导出及服务保留需确认。

research_gaps.en: No product/course access, payment, contract, sender verification, automation or recurring-subscription migration was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测商品/课程访问、支付、合同、发信验证、自动化或周期订阅迁移。
